description: Default electrical-contractor qualification model. Explicit, configurable, explainable. Tune here, not in code. Weights and thresholds are calibrated for GOVERNANCE and TESTING on SYNTHETIC data; recalibrate against real data once a live provider is approved (MISSION-003).

core_electrical_category.reason: Business is categorized as an electrical contractor/electrician.

service_area_match_full.reason: Located in the target service area.

service_area_match_partial.reason: Partially matches the target service area.

contactable.reason: At least one contact channel is available.

business_maturity.reason: Size signals indicate an established business.

non_electrical_trade.reason: Primary trade is non-electrical (e.g., handyman/plumber/HVAC/general contractor) with no electrical specialization.

adjacent_only.reason: Only adjacent services (e.g., solar/lighting) with no confirmed electrical-contractor category.

insufficient_evidence.reason: Insufficient evidence: no website, no contact channel, and no size signals.

ambiguous_no_evidence.reason: Ambiguous business with no electrical evidence.
